README.md · Author-provided

plotters-bitmap - The bitmap backend for Plotters

This is a part of plotters project. For more details, please check the following links:

  • For high-level intro of Plotters, see: Plotters on crates.io
  • Check the main repo at Plotters repo
  • For detailed documentation about this crate, check plotters-backend on docs.rs
  • You can also visit Plotters Homepage

[project]
name = "crates-io/plotters-bitmap"

[project.features]
default = ["image_encoder", "gif_backend"]
gif = ["dep:gif"]
gif_backend = ["gif", "image_encoder"]
image = ["dep:image"]
image_encoder = ["image"]

[rust]
name = "plotters_bitmap"
type = "lib"
edition = "2018"
build-script = false

[dependencies]
gif = { loaf = "crates-io/gif", version = "^0.12.0", optional = true }
image = { loaf = "crates-io/image", version = "^0.24.3", features = ["bmp", "jpeg", "png"], default-features = false, optional = true, target = "cfg(not(target_arch = \"wasm32\"))" }
plotters-backend = { loaf = "crates-io/plotters-backend", version = "^0.3.6" }
